title: Class XII Maths — the Engineering Lens
subject: mathematics
source: Personal study notes from my own Class XII Mathematics revision project (CBSE chapters 1–5, Days 1–15), where each theorem was verified in NumPy/SymPy and mapped onto aerospace, electronics and computing systems.
summary: Five chapters read as engineering structure: the equivalence triad and the leg that fails quietly, domain restriction as the price of an inverse, matrices as operators whose order is physics, the determinant as a verdict on whether an answer exists, and the corner that separates continuity from smoothness.
